column1: # Physical controller profiles: how a controller's keys reach the game (porter port --controller <id>, the GUI's Controller list; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Physical controllers").
# porter writes the chosen one into the data pack as controller.tsv, which the app reads at launch (front_android.c pad_load); the on-screen gamepad is never remapped.
#   kind     generic, handheld (an Android device with built-in controls) or controller
#   labels   what the face buttons say: xbox (A at the bottom, B right, X left, Y top), nintendo (B at the bottom, A right, Y left, X top: the Switch's own),
#            playstation (cross at the bottom, circle right, square left, triangle top)
#   keys     which Android key each face button sends: position (Android's standard: BUTTON_A is the bottom one, B the right, X the left, Y the top), or label
#            (BUTTON_A is the button labelled A: a handheld with Nintendo labels set to its Nintendo layout, as AYN's Odin style, Retroid's and Anbernic's NS modes do)
#   key=target  more keys: an Android key name (BUTTON_C, BUTTON_L2, BUTTON_1 ...) or code (the app logs "[input] controller key 188 (device 5): not mapped") to a
#            Switch button (A B X Y L R ZL ZR PLUS MINUS LS RS UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT), a face button by its place (south east west north), or none
# A handheld whose system settings switch its face buttons between a Nintendo and an Xbox layout has a row for each: the setting changes the keys, not the labels.
# Sources (2026-11): Android's key layout for the Switch Pro Controller (frameworks/base data/keyboards/Vendor_057e_Product_2009.kl: the bottom button, labelled B,
# sends BUTTON_A); Anbernic's NS / Xbox modes (NS: the keys follow the printed letters; Xbox: A moves to the bottom); the AYN Odin's Odin / Xbox controller styles.
# AYN Thor (Android 13, "Odin Controller" 2020:0111, 2026-11-10): getevent showed the right button (A) sending 0x130, which its Vendor_2020_Product_0111.kl makes
# BUTTON_A, and the bottom one (B) 0x131 (BUTTON_B), so the standard mapping swapped A and B; with ayn-thor, Super Mario Odyssey's A confirmed and B went back.
